issue: Duplicate username and duplicate email are not rejected during registration
actual: Register/sign-in/sign-out/sign-back-in flow for a unique account works correctly. However, registering a second account with username 'qatester1' (already taken) but a different email succeeded and logged in as a new/duplicate 'qatester1'. Similarly, registering a third account with a new username 'qatester2' but the email already used by 'qatester1' (qatester1@example.com) also succeeded without any rejection or error message.
evidence: After submitting register form with username=qatester1 (duplicate) email=different@example.com, app redirected to home logged in as 'qatester1'. After submitting username=qatester2 email=qatester1@example.com (duplicate email), app redirected to home logged in as 'qatester2', no duplicate error shown.

Edited bio to 'QA automation enthusiast who loves testing forums.' and interests to 'Testing, Automation, Chess'; after Save, profile.bio and profile.interests display the saved values ('Testing Automation Chess' rendered as tags).

issue: No missing-field feedback shown on invalid submit
actual: Submitting the New Thread form with no category, title, or body correctly does not create a discussion (page stays on /new-thread), but no error message, field highlighting, or other feedback identifies which fields are missing. DOM search for error/invalid/required text found no matches.
evidence: After clicking Create Thread with all fields empty, page remained at /new-thread with no visible validation message.

Created thread with category=Technology, title='QA Zebra Testing Thread', body='This is a unique zebra body...'. Thread detail page displays exact title/body/author. Thread also appears correctly listed under /category/tech.

Category 'Technology' showed only tech threads (thread-7, thread-1, thread-1787713829062). Switching to 'General Discussion' showed only its thread (thread-2, 'Share your favorite productivity tips!'), confirming result set changes per selected category.
Posted reply 'This is a test reply from qaengineer for QA verification.' without reload; it appeared in thread.replies collection and thread.reply-count updated from '0 replies' to '1 replies'.

Clicking upvote on thread-1 (author TechExplorer) increased count 47->48 and added active styling (bg-primary/10 text-primary). Clicking again removed the upvote, count returned to 47 and active styling was removed, both updates immediate with no reload.

issue: Reply total displayed does not match actual replies listed
actual: On thread-1 ('What programming language should I learn in 2024?'), the header/summary shows '23 replies' but the detail view's Replies section heading reads 'Replies (2)' and only 2 replies are actually rendered (reply-1 by GameMaster42, reply-2 by NewsHound). The displayed total (23) does not match the number of replies listed (2).
evidence: thread.reply-count observable = '23 replies'; browser_snapshot shows heading 'Replies (2)' with exactly 2 reply items rendered, no pagination control present.

Search 'zebra' returned only 'QA Zebra Testing Thread' (title match). Search 'ZEBRA' (different case) returned same single result confirming case-insensitivity. Search 'xyznonexistentkeyword123' returned empty list with message 'No threads found. Try adjusting your search terms.'

Most Active initially ordered 89,67,45,41,38,34,31,24,1 (descending by replies). Added 4 replies to thread-8 (38->42). Re-viewing Most Active shows new order 89,67,45,42(thread-8),41(thread-7),34,31,24,1 — thread-8 moved above thread-7, confirming re-ranking on activity change while list stays sorted descending.

Trending initially ordered 156,124,92,89,78,67,56,47,0 (descending upvotes). Added 4 upvotes from 4 distinct new accounts to thread-2 (89->93), pushing it above thread-7 (92). Re-viewing Trending shows updated order 156,124,93(thread-2),92(thread-7),78,67,56,47,0 confirming re-rank while staying fully descending.

issue: No recent time window stated or enforced for Trending/Most Active
actual: Neither the Trending nor Most Active view displays any stated time window (e.g. 'last 7 days', 'this week'). Both lists rank threads purely by all-time upvote/reply totals: threads timestamped 'over 2 years ago' rank at the very top alongside a thread created minutes ago, with no visible filtering or window label anywhere on the page.
evidence: Full page snapshot of Trending view shows top threads with 'time: over 2 years ago' (e.g. thread-6, thread-4) interleaved with a thread created '4 minutes ago' (QA Zebra Testing Thread), and no text mentioning a recent/time-bound window near the 'Trending Discussions' or 'Most Active Discussions' headings.

Clicked author link 'WellnessWanderer' from thread-2's listing; navigated to /profile/user-4 showing username (WellnessWanderer), 'Joined almost 3 years ago', '987 reputation', bio text, interest tags (Yoga, Meditation, Nutrition, Travel), and 'Threads by WellnessWanderer (2)' listing thread-2 and thread-5.

issue: Login succeeds with an incorrect password
actual: Logging in with email qaengineer@example.com (registered password 'test123') and an incorrect password 'wrongpassword' did not show any error and instead created a logged-in session as 'qaengineer' (nav.profile shows 'qaengineer', redirected to home page).
evidence: After submitting login form with wrong password, page navigated to '/' and semantic_snapshot shows nav.profile.name = 'qaengineer', confirming an authenticated session was created despite the incorrect password.

As qaengineer: set bio/interests, upvoted thread-3 (56->57, active styling), had authored thread with 1 reply. Logged out and back in with same credentials (same session, no reload): thread-3 upvote count and active styling unchanged (57, bg-primary/10 class present), profile bio/interests unchanged ('Persistence test bio for qaengineer.' / Persistence QA Testing), authored thread 'QA Zebra Testing Thread' still listed with 1 reply.

issue: Community/category counts do not update to reflect actual created records
actual: Community Stats sidebar shows stats.threads=1,045 and stats.members=892 unchanged even after creating 1 new discussion and registering 5 new accounts (qaengineer, voter1-4) in this session; stats.replies remains 4,823 despite 6 replies being added during testing. Additionally, category 'Technology (243)' claims 243 threads but the actual /category/tech view only lists 3 threads (thread-7, thread-1, and the newly created QA thread), showing the displayed counts do not reflect the discussions/replies/members actually present in the forum.
evidence: stats.threads/stats.members/stats.replies observables unchanged before and after creating a thread, 5 accounts, and 6 replies. category 'Technology (243)' vs 3 actual listed threads in /category/tech.

issue: Unauthenticated access to discussion creation results in a blank page, not a usable sign-in screen
actual: While logged out, navigating to /new-thread does not redirect to a usable Login screen. The page renders completely blank (only the notification region, no form, no message, no login prompt) and the URL stays at /new-thread. Console shows a React warning 'You should call navigate() in a React.useEffect(), not when your component is first rendered', indicating a broken redirect attempt. There is no way to return to discussion creation after authenticating because the sign-in screen never appears.
evidence: browser_snapshot of /new-thread while logged out shows only 'region Notifications alt+T' with no other content; console warning about improper navigate() call during render.

issue: No state persists across a page reload
actual: After a full page reload, all in-session state is lost: the logged-in user (qaengineer) is signed out (nav shows Login/Register instead of profile), the newly created 'QA Zebra Testing Thread' no longer appears in the thread list, thread-8's reply count reverted from 42 back to 38, thread-2's upvotes reverted from 93 back to 89, and thread-1's replies reverted from 24 back to 23. Registered accounts (qatester1, qatester2, voter1-4, qaengineer) are also no longer valid for login after a reload.
evidence: Pre-reload threads.list included thread-1787713829062 (QA Zebra Testing Thread) with thread-8=42 replies, thread-2=93 upvotes, thread-1=24 replies, and nav showed 'qaengineer' logged in. Post-reload threads.list has only the 8 original seed threads, thread-8=38, thread-2=89, thread-1=23 replies, and nav shows Login/Register (logged out).
